column2: What distinguishes serosa from adventitia, and which covers most of the oesophagus?
column3: Serosa is mesothelium over connective tissue, while adventitia binds fixed segments to surrounding structures; most thoracic oesophagus has adventitia and only its short abdominal segment has serosa.
